rationale: This is not a genuine missing specification: ExecSpecEq::exec_eq already determines res from the two deep views. Any duplicate is redundant, while a concrete HashSet-view equality contract is unsound without key-model and deep-view injectivity assumptions.
risks: The external_body prevents verification of runtime behavior against the inherited contract.
Non-injective K::deep_view can make runtime HashSet equality disagree with deep-view equality.
